config.recommended_runtime: GPU (T4 is enough); ~25-35 min (router features on 100k-sample frames dominate)

recorded_notebook.hash_scope: Notebook text loaded during the recorded run

deviations: frame = 10,000 symbols (100,000 samples) for router AND experts; router trained on full frames (Exp 1/2 used 10k-sample frames)
structured experts: LSTM 0-20 = Exp 2 'fixed020' recipe; ALE-32 NLMS (delay 20, mu 0.2); JSR gate on an energy-based estimate
monolithic LSTM: same recipe trained on all four jammer types (fixed, JSR 0-20) — R3-3 single-model baseline
MMSE expert not evaluated separately: it does not change hard decisions (BER == no-correction); broadband -> pass-through for BER
pulse expert = reference PulseBlankerExpert calibrated as in Phase 3 (30 clean frames, seeds 600+); BER on surviving symbols
protocol: Table II seeds, 100 trials (paper 20); clean frames audited (100/condition)
condition 'random': NEW sweep/pulse generators + random NB frequency; fixed notch only under 'fixed'
